Source-preserving augmentation spike — Front views

Can a messy seller photograph become a clean Product Truth input without redrawing the garment? Three Front images. Segmentation is pretrained SAM2 (facebook/sam2.1-hiera-tiny, 8×8 point grid, restored from 66eef6d scripts/source_sam2_spike.py); the automatic pick is the SigLIP cross-view ranker from 5977e71 scripts/source_mask_selector.py, unmodified except for being aimed at a chosen slot. Everything after the mask is deterministic: EXIF rotation, hole fill, crop and pad, a 2048 square canvas, a neutral backdrop, a 2px alpha feather. 0 generative API calls. No garment pixel is sharpened, smoothed, recoloured or invented — the RGB-preserved figure is measured by comparing the canonical image back to the source inside the eroded mask. A hand or hanger over the garment is labelled and kept, never reconstructed. Click any image for full resolution.
